meta.title: Reviewed banking-access disruptions
meta.about: Each event is entered by hand from its sources and reviewed. country_code is ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (SSD, PSE, XKX and ESH are mapped to Natural Earth's SDS, PSX, KOS and SAH). event_type: technical_outage, withdrawal_limits, capital_controls, deposit_freeze or bank_failure. severity 1-5 (see docs/banking-access.md). confidence: social, multiple_reports or official. affected_people_est or affected_population_pct may be null when no source gives the reach: the map then shows the extent as unknown. Times are ISO 8601; resolved_time null means ongoing. Use 'official' only when a regulator, central bank or the bank itself is among the sources.

events.affected_basis: No source counts the people under the withdrawal limits. For scale only: a February 2026 Ankura study estimated that about 550,000 depositors may not recover their savings even within the proposed USD 100,000 ceiling.
events.summary: Informal capital controls since the 2019 crisis: deposits held in banks, cash withdrawals capped by central bank circulars 158 and 166 (reported raised to USD 800 and USD 400 a month in June 2025). A deposit recovery law was still under debate in spring 2026.
